- Shorts are here: a Shorts tab in the bottom bar, Shorts shelves in your feeds and search, and every Short (from a card, a link, a notification) opens in the Shorts player. Swipe up for the next one
- Double tap a Short to like it, with a heart that pops where you tapped. The like button is a heart now
- Hold the left or right side for 2x speed; hold the middle for the menu
- The ⋮ menu on Shorts: captions, auto scroll (on to the next Short when one ends), description, quality, audio track and speed
- Shorts show their channel's picture and name again
- Dubbed videos: choose the audio track (language) in video settings. Videos now play in their original language by default
- New setting: turn Shorts off to hide the tab and the shelves; Shorts then open as normal videos
